proof_body:
by
  intro m n a b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, h1, h2⟩
    have d1 : (Int.gcd m n : ℤ) ∣ a - x := (Int.gcd_dvd_left m n).trans h1.dvd
    have d2 : (Int.gcd m n : ℤ) ∣ b - x := (Int.gcd_dvd_right m n).trans h2.dvd
    have := dvd_sub d1 d2
    simpa using this
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    have hb := Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab m n
    refine ⟨a - m * Int.gcdA m n * c, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply Int.ModEq.symm
      apply Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2
      exact ⟨-(Int.gcdA m n * c), by ring⟩
    · apply Int.ModEq.symm
      apply Int.modEq_iff_dvd.2
      refine ⟨Int.gcdB m n * c, ?_⟩
      rw [hb] at hc
      linear_combination hc
target_source: ∀ m n a b : ℤ, (∃ x : ℤ, x ≡ a [ZMOD m] ∧ x ≡ b [ZMOD n]) ↔ (Int.gcd m n : ℤ) ∣ a - b
